description:
I went on a blind date as a stand-in for my older sister… only to find out the man was my supervising professor at the university hospital. Jeong Dasom agreed to take her sister’s place on a blind date for a small allowance of 300,000 won. But her date turned out to be a professor in the Emergency Medicine Department at SJ University Hospital—the very place where she was about to start her residency! He was infamous in the ER for being cold and ruthless, and if he found out she was just a substitute, her hospital life would be over before it even began. “Since we’re both at a perfectly suitable age for marriage, I’d like us to seriously consider seeing each other. What do you think?” …Wait. Was that basically a proposal just now? No, that’s not the problem. Should I confess right now—“I’m not your actual blind date, I’m just a stand-in!”? Or should I just quietly run away? Just as her mind went into full panic mode, an emergency call came in, and the man rushed back to the hospital. Not long after, the two met again—this time as professor and resident. Will Dasom be able to keep the truth about the substitute blind date hidden until the end? A clumsy, soft-hearted resident, Jeong Dasom, tangled up in a fake blind date, and a so-called cold-blooded emergency medicine professor, Tae Kang-hyuk—who, for some reason, is gentle only with her. A heart-racing medical romance set in the emergency room!
